newsitem.title: USA: US spot propane steady after midday bounce.
newsitem.headline: US spot propane steady after midday bounce.

text.p: U.S. prices of spot propane, a key liquefied petroleum gas, were largely steady in late trade on Thursday after rebounding earlier from yesterday's fall.
In the U.S. Gulf Coast, Mont Belvieu, Texas, spot propane held onto its nearly one cent gain at midday at between 34.75 cents and 35.25 cents a gallon.
Midwest sellers rose their offers up a tad to 35.50 cents, with many buyers still grouped around 35.00 cents. The half and 35.25 cent parcels were done.
"We were somewhat busy this morning with people covering their shorts before crude went up further, but it is dead now," said a Houston trader.
The butane markets were also quiet. A Belvieu ethane parcel sold for 1950 cents. ((--Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk 1212 859-1631))
